title: I-635 Dallas photos LBJ East

pageHeader.title: Roadside Views, LBJ East
pageHeader.subTitle: Project completion ceremony took place on Sept. 14, 2026

text:
The $1.7 billion LBJ East project, starting at the I-30 interchange (including complete interchange reconstruction) and proceeding west to Greenville Road near US 75, began in 2020. All main lanes were open by early summer 2026, and as of August 2026 final work on the managed lanes was being done.

A project completion ceremony took place on September 14, 2026, in conjunction with the opening of the managed lanes on the same day. (See last photo)

These photos are from the east and west ends of the project. The middle section is difficult to photograph from the roadside. See the driving views for photos of the middle section.
